# AIGVDet usage restriction

The authors state in their README:

> The code and dataset is released only for academic research. Commercial usage is strictly prohibited.

Source: https://github.com/multimediaFor/AIGVDet/blob/5e0d5dd7c5ecf96040608676a2965502ffed2555/README.md

This restriction applies to the included upstream code and its adaptation. It is not an MIT grant. Weights are not redistributed.
